answer: Achievements are logged as public receipts into a personal vault, accumulating into one nontradable relic that grants voting rights and steadily erodes across a rolling six-month horizon without fresh wins. A sybil farmer spawning a thousand shells discovers each vault opens empty, and every shell's own relic must be fed with separately earned results to carry any voice. What blocks them isn't budget size but the hard daily ceiling on genuinely validated, non-copyable problem completions.
